info.title: s1kd-tools — command-line interface
info.description: C#/.NET port of the s1kd-tools command-line suite for creating and manipulating S1000D (technical publications) CSDB objects. A single `s1kd` executable with sub-commands (s1kd metadata, s1kd render, …); also supports multi-call dispatch via argv[0] (e.g. s1kd-metadata).
